summary: For z/OS managed nodes, set PYTHONSTDINENCODING=cp1047 and language environment variables (_BPXK_AUTOCVT, _CEE_RUNOPTS, _TAG_REDIR_*) in inventory, play or task environment for auto-conversion and file tagging.
questions: What environment variables does Ansible need for z/OS targets?
Where should I set _BPXK_AUTOCVT for Ansible?

answer_card.title: z/OS environment settings for Ansible
answer_card.answer_md:
Set in `environment` (play, block or task) for z/OS hosts:

```yaml
environment:
  PYTHONSTDINENCODING: "cp1047"
  _BPXK_AUTOCVT: "ON"
  _CEE_RUNOPTS: "FILETAG(AUTOCVT,AUTOTAG) POSIX(ON)"
  _TAG_REDIR_ERR: "txt"
  _TAG_REDIR_IN: "txt"
  _TAG_REDIR_OUT: "txt"
```

You can keep them in inventory vars (e.g. `group_vars/all.yml`) and reference them.
